name: google-ad-manager

verification.follow_up: Ratify and run the independent connector evidence contract (probe 25.6).

_source_note: REST-only. GAM SOAP is deprecated/removed; the Interactive Reports API (admanager.googleapis.com/v1/networks/{nc}/reports) is the sole data path. Reports are ASYNC jobs: submit -> poll operation -> fetch rows. Catalogue (765 dims / 527 metrics, revision 20260528) + REST client ported from C:/Users/littl/Programmation/gam-native (see gam-connector-from-gam-native memory).

report_profiles._comment: Pivot profile under GAM report type HISTORICAL. Metrics/dimensions reference catalogue field_ids (= snake_case of the GAM enum, e.g. ad_server_revenue); canonical names (ad_revenue) come from canonical_metric_mapping. MONEY metrics stay in MICROS; ÷1e6 once at read.

_canonical_mapping_note: TODO(catalogue port): these are the core-tier seeds only. The full source->canonical mapping is derived per field from the ported catalogue. SEMANTIC GUARD (see gam-connector-from-gam-native memory): AUDIENCE_SEGMENT_* (GAM ad-server audiences) must NOT share a canonical target with GA4-built audiences; GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_* (GA<->GAM ad-monetization link) must NOT map to the same canonical metric as GA4 behavioral revenue/engagement. Distinct provenance + canonical targets.

account_topology._comment: GAM hierarchy: the reporting entity (selection_level) is the NETWORK (a REST report targets networks/{networkCode}/reports). discover_accounts lists networks the token can reach via networks.list. Core owns selection/access-check/trial/backfill (AD-2).

quota._comment: TODO: confirm GAM REST quota. Placeholder conservative values; the report job is async so the cost is per submitted job + polls. See https://developers.google.com/ad-manager/api/rate_limits

_error_map_note: TODO(catalogue port): GAM REST 400s embed a (type.googleapis.com/google.ads.admanager.v1.X) detail and, like all Google APIs, set error.code to the numeric HTTP status. Decide during port whether a provider code map refines anything beyond pure-HTTP classification (401->auth_expired, 403->permission_denied, 400->invalid_request, 5xx->provider_transient, 429->RateLimitError); the gam-native _summarize_gam_error / _raise_report_status logic is the reference.
